name: Priya S.
quote: The wedding cake was even more beautiful in person than the sketch they designed with us. Guests are still talking about the flavor!

name: Marcus T.
quote: Ordered a last-minute birthday cake and they made it feel completely custom. Incredibly friendly and fast on WhatsApp too.

name: Daniel K.
quote: The geode cake was a total showstopper at our anniversary party. Beautifully made and genuinely delicious, not just pretty.
